title: New City Clerk Hired; Major Lawsuits Discussed
summary:
*   James E. Aldridge was appointed as the new City Clerk with an annual salary of $34,000.
*   The city held closed-door discussions on significant pending lawsuits, including cases involving HL&P and Brown and Root.
*   Other executive session topics included personnel matters and the potential sale or lease of real estate.

Mayor Mullen called to order the Special Called Meeting of the Council scheduled for 4:00
p.m. and noted the presence of all Councilmembers. He announced Council will convene in a
closed or executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraph g of Article 6252-17, Texas
Revised Civil Statutes annotated, Personnel Matters; and after such closed or executive
session, any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter considered in the
closed or executive session will be made in open session, should such action, decision or
vote be necessary.
RECESS
Council recessed for executive session at 4:40 p.m. and resumed its recessed meeting at
5:45 p.m.
NEW CITY CLERK NAMED
Motion
The Council, on Councilmember Duncan's motion, Councilmember Spaeth's second, approved the
appointment of James E. Aldridge as
City Clerk of Austin, Texas. (7-0 Vote)
Motion
The Council, on Councilmember Duncan's motion, Councilmember Rose's second, approved a
salary of $34,000 annually for City Clerk Aldridge. (7-0 Vote)
EXECUTIVE SESSION & RECESS
Council recessed its meeting at 5:50 p.m. to return to executive session to discuss
pending litigation: a. City of Austin v. HL&P et al; City of Austin et al v Brown and Root
et al, Section 2, Paragraph e; and b. Sale or lease of real property, Section 2, Paragraph
f. After such closed or executive session, any action or vote necessary will be made in
open session. Council adjourned its meeting at 8:00 p.m.
